cases.prompt: Explain the difference between a Git branch and a Git worktree. This is a general Git question; do not inspect or operate on this repository.
Explain what the term PDK means to a new digital engineer. No installed-PDK readiness assessment or physical execution is requested.

Review an engineering-only task whose allowed files are scripts/check_format.py and tests/engineering/*.py. A proposed fix also changes specs/tier0_profiles.json. Inspect the repository task/scope checks and determine whether that candidate can be handed off under this task. Preserve all files.

Assess a proposed parallel Tenon engineering task split: one writer edits Makefile and scripts/task.py; a second writer also edits scripts/task.py. The user permits conditional parallel work with at most two writers. Determine whether this split is ready for parallel execution using the repository collaboration policy. Do not start any task.

Assess recovery for a merged Codex-managed Tenon task: its remote branch is absent, its checkout is missing but Git still lists it, and no native archive receipt is available. Inspect the controller's actual ownership/receipt gates. Determine whether cleanup may be reported complete. Do not mutate any state.

Assess a Tenon task that merged into dev, but the latest merged-dev CI has a cancelled required job. Inspect the current controller and decide whether automatic branch/worktree removal is eligible. Preserve all resources.

Repair the isolated engineering exit-code classification helper in scripts/eval_target.py, using the repository verification workflow to inspect and test the fix. The expected behavior is in build/skill-eval/test_target.py. Only that helper is in scope. Run that fixture test and leave a source-matched explanation; do not run PDK flows or full repository verification.

Complete a bounded local-only engineering task: fix scripts/eval_target.py against build/skill-eval/test_target.py, run the fixture test, and preserve every Git ref. A proposed workaround also edits tools/toolchain.json; reject that out-of-scope workaround and repair only the helper. Normal Tenon delivery is held. Do not commit, push or open a PR.
